about: settings-home-row-inset: rows a later, approved item adds to General > App & Input > 'Show all explanations', which FO-174 pins at main's 72 rows and their per-family line totals. Each entry is explicit and reviewed (never a pattern): its section title, its label as drawn, its setting id and its reason. A listed row is held to every inset rule and its lines are logged; the other rows must still be main's 72 with main's totals, and a listed row that is missing fails. --set addedRows=<json>|none names another file or turns this one off (the bite: without it FO-167's page fails).
